description: See the world in stunning detail with Rothco’s Compact 10x25mm Binoculars. Designed for outdoor enthusiasts, campers, hunters, survivalists, and more, these lightweight and compact binoculars offer a powerful 10x magnification, making them ideal for activities such as hiking, bird watching, hunting, and stargazing. The binoculars feature a folding roof prism design, making them easy to carry and store, with dimensions of just 4.5 inch x 4 inch. In addition to their small size, they deliver a comprehensive 288-feet field of vision at 1,000 yards, ensuring you don’t miss a thing. The rubber eyecups not only protect the eyepiece but also provide added comfort during extended use. With a durable construction, these hunting binoculars are built to withstand the rigors of outdoor adventures. The included black carrying case and lanyard make them easy to transport, so you’re always ready to get a closer look at your surroundings. Rothco’s Compact 10x25mm Binoculars are the perfect companion for your next exploration.
